Gnat/Ajeet pole-mounted near the EAC HQ gate; bharat-rakshak gives E-256. Source warbirds.in (EAC website photo), bharat-rakshak.

Second MiG-21FL listed by bharat-rakshak at Eastern Air Command HQ Shillong (aviationmuseum.eu lists a MiG-21FL cockpit section in the museum - may be this airframe). Unverified.
